$doc: ALL global difficulty and economy tuning. Every knob is a multiplier on the values in the other data files (1 = as written there). Switch the whole game with the one line below ("preset"), or per device in Settings > Tuning. See docs/TUNING.md for what each knob does and safe ranges.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: The intended challenge. Normal is won by a good plan, not by any plan.

original.label: Original
original.description: The easier tuning of the first playable slice.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.description: Easier than the slice: for friends, first-timers and testing.

assist.$doc: Player-chosen helpers (Settings > Assist). Assisted runs are flagged: they still give crowns but do not set records, complete achievements or count for the daily challenge.
